signature.name: VTask.augment
signature.type: {V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] -> (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) -> {X : V} -> (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) -> (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0) -> ChainComplex V ℕ

conventions.point: differential at non-adjacent or out-of-range index pairs
conventions.statement: For index pairs `(i, j)` that are not of the form `(n+1, n)` (i.e., where the complex's shape condition rules out a nonzero differential), the differential `(VTask.augment C f w).d i j` is zero.
conventions.note: This is the standard chain-complex convention inherited by the augmented complex; in particular `d 0 j = 0` for all `j` and `d (i+2) 0 = 0`.

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) {X : V} (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0) (i j : ℕ), (VTask.augment C f w).d (i + 1) (j + 1) = C.d i j

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) {X : V} (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((VTask.augment C f w).d 1 0) ((VTask.augment C f w).d 0 0) = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) {X : V} (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((VTask.augment C f w).d 2 1) ((VTask.augment C f w).d 1 0) = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) {X : V} (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0), (VTask.augment C f w).d 1 0 ≠ (0 : C.X 0 ⟶ X) ∨ f = (0 : C.X 0 ⟶ X)
